rule.zh: 参考集原样保留；同一恢复阶段上被更短机制支配的剪除（同阶段取最小值，不相加）；其余在判定规模（研究中最大的规模）上各拓扑的有效 goodput Shapley 均 ≥ 阈值、且叠加在参考集上各拓扑都有有效 goodput 增益 → G_eff 候选（进入分配），交付 goodput Shapley 均 ≥ 阈值且叠加在参考集上有交付增益 → 只保交付 goodput，否则剪除；决定性的 Shapley 比较离阈值不足一个抽样半宽时为未定（v5.6，2026-10-29：规则指标从 A_op 改为有效 goodput；v5.7，2026-10-29：加入参考集增益与抽样半宽，有效 goodput 按精确更新模型）
rule.en: reference set kept as is; a mechanism dominated by a shorter one on the same recovery stage is pruned (minimum on a stage, never the sum); otherwise effective-goodput Shapley ≥ threshold at the decision scale (the largest scale studied) and an effective-goodput gain on top of the reference set, both on every architecture → G_eff candidate (enters the allocation), delivered-goodput Shapley ≥ threshold with a delivered gain on top of the reference set → delivered-only, else pruned; a verdict whose deciding Shapley comparison lies within one sampled half-width of the threshold is unresolved (v5.6, 2026-10-29: the rule’s metric moved from A_op to the effective goodput; v5.7, 2026-10-29: the reference-set gain and the sampled half-width, the effective goodput on the exact renewal model)

parameters.source: ReMAP f53ab7e packages/contracts/src/audit-extensions.ts: extensionScenario() generic fields (eligibleShare 1, or 0.5 of the CORE silent risk for D-SDC-FP8 / FP4; success 0.95; failureSeconds 0; overhead 0, D-ABFT 0.001) + parameterSets (R-LINK-LOCAL pause 2 s; R-FABRIC-DEGRADE pause 2 s, exposed communication 0.3, remaining bandwidth 0.75, repair 1,800 s; H-CONTROL-CONTINUITY pause 1 s; R-WARM-PROCESS / R-RUNTIME-SNAPSHOT startup 20 / 15 s; R-CANN-GRAPH graph 7.5 s; C-ASYNC block 1 s, lag 10 s; C-LOSSLESS ratio 2, decompress 10 s; D-RECOVERY-CLASSIFY manual 0.001; D-SDC-FP8 / FP4 coverage 0.95 in 1 s; D-ABFT conditional coverage 0.9; D-NET-SDC coverage 0.95 in 1 s; H-SDC-SCREEN reduction 0.25; R-HCCL-ELASTIC communication 15 s), eligibility × success folded by expectation where the transform is deterministic (riskShare 0.5 × 0.95, conditionalMissDetection 0.9 × 0.95, D-NET-SDC 0.95 × 0.95, C-ASYNC 4 × 0.05 + 1 × 0.95)
parameters.note: ReMAP labels them an explicit scenario (evidence “scenario”, “never a measured default”); reconciled against the file 2026-10-21, all 15 blocks agree

baseline.source: ReMAP reference set (mechanism-policy.json of the expert review 2026-10-09): D-SDC, R-SDC, R-REPLAY, R-PROCESS, R-ELASTIC, C-FAST with the library’s parameters (scripts/remap-param-check.ts: SAME)

candidates.source: pruning rule on the four built-in records’ Shapley studies at 500k (docs/backup/arch-mechanism-shapley, 300 permutations, regenerated 2026-10-29 with the effective-goodput values): effective-goodput Shapley ≥ 0.15 pt on every architecture, not dominated on a shared stage (hacd prune reproduces the lists); v5.6 moved C-ASYNC in (+0.17–0.20 pt) and R-FABRIC-DEGRADE out (+0.07–0.17 pt)

goodputOnly.source: pruning rule: delivered-goodput Shapley ≥ 0.15 pt on every architecture, effective-goodput Shapley below the threshold

pruned.source: pruning rule: dominated on the startup stage (R-WARM-PROCESS, R-CANN-GRAPH by R-RUNTIME-SNAPSHOT), below the threshold on both metrics (effective and delivered goodput: R-HCCL-ELASTIC, D-SLOW, R-FABRIC-DEGRADE) or without a gain on top of the reference set (v5.7: C-ASYNC, whose save reduction C-FAST already provides)

levers.source: HAC-D v4 allocation strategies (docs/markdown/PLAN_V4_NPU_TOPOLOGY_FIRST.md §8, packages/core/src/strategy DEFAULT_LEVERS): automatic attempt ≥ 60 s, automatic success ≤ 99.9 %, manual recovery ≥ 30 min; efforts 3 / 3 / 2 are engineering judgement

derate.source: HAC-D derated yardstick (packages/core/src/mechanisms/plan.ts DERATE_DEFAULT): coverage, detection targets and shares −5 pt, success −8 pt, times and overheads × 1.5, rate reductions × 0.5 — engineering margins; the automatic-success lever is derated on its failure probability × 1.5 (99.9 % → 99.85 %, v5.5 R1), the checkpoint period of C-FAST / C-MEM is not derated (the save time is)

efforts.source: library efforts 1–5 per mechanism (MechanismDef.effort, the audit catalog’s integration effort), not overridden by this set

prune.threshold.source: 0.15 pt; v5.7: the committed studies use 1200 permutations, the effective-goodput half-widths at 500k are at most 0.18 pt (the reference mechanisms) and every verdict lies at least 8 half-widths from the threshold or is decided by the reference-gain test (hacd prune lists any unresolved verdict)

prune.dominated.source: audit library overlap rule: mechanisms on one recovery stage take the minimum time per event (R-WARM-PROCESS 20 s and R-CANN-GRAPH 37.5 s startup vs R-RUNTIME-SNAPSHOT 15 s); with eligible shares below 1 the dominance is approximate — the dominated mechanism keeps the events the snapshot does not cover (same-stage expectation, MODEL_REFERENCE §24.2), worth at most 3.0e-6 of A_op with all players on at 500k (second recheck N7), far below the 0.15 pt threshold

prune.metric.source: v5.6 (user’s decision 2026-10-28): the report’s acceptance metric is the effective goodput, so the candidate rule reads the effective-goodput Shapley; the A_op verdicts of v5.5 are in the git history

verdicts.source: reasons restated on 2026-10-29 from the v5.7 studies (1200 permutations, the effective and delivered goodput on the exact renewal model; ranges over the four topologies at 500k); C-ASYNC moved to pruned by the reference-gain test; the bespoke clauses of v5 kept
